# SodaPeak

> SodaPeak is a once-daily botanical gummy for adult men, formulated to support energy, stamina, healthy circulation, libido and overall male vitality. This site is an independent affiliate review and information page.

## Key facts
- Product type: Dietary supplement (chewable gummy), for adults 18+
- Serving: 1 gummy once daily; 30 gummies per bottle (30-day supply); 10 calories, 3 g sugar per gummy
- Proprietary blend (82 mg, ~567 mg dry powder equivalent): Muira Puama Extract, Maca Extract, Catuaba Extract, Green Tea Extract, Caffeine (5 mg), Ashwagandha, L-Arginine, Tribulus Terrestris, Horny Goat Weed Extract
- Other ingredients: corn syrup, cane sugar, water, apple pectin, sorbitol liquid, natural flavors, citric acid, sodium citrate dihydrate
- Assembled in the USA; produced in a GMP facility
- Price: 2 bottles $158 ($79/bottle) + shipping; 4 bottles $177 ($44/bottle) free US shipping; 8 bottles $294 ($37/bottle) free US shipping
- Bonuses (4 and 8 bottle packages): 5 free digital guides
- Guarantee: 60-day money-back guarantee; no subscription
- Purchase: https://sodapeak-gummies.vercel.app/#pricing
